initial_adversarial_test.description: corrupted the zero-padded (mask=0) feature and lorentz-vector slots with large IID Gaussian noise (unconstrained px,py,pz,E, i.e. not required to satisfy E>=|p|), re-ran
initial_adversarial_test.note: output was non-finite (NaN); root-caused by a follow-up isolation test (see corrected_physical_test and CANARY_RUNBOOK.md section 4) to unphysical (spacelike / negative-energy) synthetic 4-vectors violating E>=|p|, which drive ParT's internal rapidity formula (log of a negative argument in pairwise_lv_fts) to NaN for ANY constituent pair referencing that 4-vector, independent of masking. Confirmed by a minimal reproduction: even a jet's REAL (non-padded, mask=1) constituents alone, when given literally random non-physical 4-vectors, already produce non-finite output with zero padding involved at all. This is not a masking defect.

corrected_physical_test.description: on 60 real QCD jets, replaced each jet's padded (mask=0) feature/lorentz-vector slots with ANOTHER real jet's genuine, physically-valid constituent content (donor jet's real constituents, resized to fill the padding), keeping mask unchanged at 0 for those slots; re-ran and compared to the true (zero-padded) output

padding_mask_sensitivity_check.verdict: Masking is correctly and exactly (bitwise) implemented for any physically valid input, including non-zero content in padded slots. The architecture is numerically fragile (produces NaN) only for physically impossible 4-vectors (E<|p|), which never occur in real Yang-Li constituent data (verified: part_pt native equals hypot(px,py) exactly, FEATURE_COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md section 1) and never occur in real zero-padding (which is exactly (0,0,0,0), a degenerate but non-negative-energy, non-spacelike case that does not trigger the rapidity singularity).
